$comment: Table editing (feature 006): the feature's catalogue, deep-merged into the base catalogue by ui/src/i18n/index.ts; en, ru and uk stay in parity (tools/i18n-check.mjs). Keys, placeholders and plural families are those of contracts/resource-formats.md §9: the Add menu's Table structure submenu and its 24 command labels (menu.tableStructure.<name>, <name> being the command id without "table."), their tooltips and descriptions, the Hotkeys page group, the context-menu entries, the reasons of unavailable commands (tables.reason.<code>, the part after "{{command}}: "), the problem phrases of irregular tables, the Validate and mark texts, the mark's popover, the Table properties dialog's fields, the two bar labels and the status-bar messages.

insertRowAbove.description: Insert empty rows above the caret's row or the selected block

insertRowBelow.description: Insert empty rows below the caret's row or the selected block

deleteRow.description: Delete the caret's row or the rows of the selected block

insertColumnLeft.description: Insert empty columns to the left of the caret's column or the selected block

insertColumnRight.description: Insert empty columns to the right of the caret's column or the selected block

deleteColumn.description: Delete the caret's column or the columns of the selected block

mergeCells.description: Merge the selected block into one cell

splitCell.description: Split a merged cell into one cell per position

toggleHeaderCell.description: Switch the caret's cell between header and normal

makeHeaderCells.description: Make every cell of the selected block a header cell

makeNormalCells.description: Make every cell of the selected block a normal cell

toggleHeaderRow.description: Make the cells of the caret's row header cells, or normal cells when all already are

toggleHeaderColumn.description: Make the cells of the caret's column header cells, or normal cells when all already are

repair.description: Make an irregular table regular without deleting any content

moveRowUp.description: Move the caret's row or the selected rows up

moveRowDown.description: Move the caret's row or the selected rows down

moveColumnLeft.description: Move the caret's column or the selected columns to the left

moveColumnRight.description: Move the caret's column or the selected columns to the right

duplicateRow.description: Insert a copy of the caret's row or the selected rows below them

duplicateColumn.description: Insert a copy of the caret's column or the selected columns to their right

paragraphBefore.description: Insert an empty paragraph directly before the table

paragraphAfter.description: Insert an empty paragraph directly after the table

reason.only-row: the table has only one row; use Delete table
reason.all-rows: the selection covers every row; use Delete table
reason.only-column: the table has only one column; use Delete table
reason.all-columns: the selection covers every column; use Delete table

merged-crosses-border.row: a merged cell crosses the border of the row
merged-crosses-border.column: a merged cell crosses the border of the column

no-neighbour.left: there is no column to the left
no-neighbour.right: there is no column to the right

reason.needs-block: select a block of at least two cells
reason.regular: the table has nothing to repair

span-past-edge.column: the span would reach past the last column
span-past-edge.row: the span would reach past the last row

reason.merge-needs-block: A merged cell starts above or to the left of this cell; select the cells and use Merge cells.
reason.too-large: the table is too large to edit
reason.invalid-id: not a valid FB2 identifier: no spaces, not starting with a digit
reason.duplicate-id: another element of the book already uses {{id}}
reason.invalid-lang: "{{value}}" is not a language tag: letters and digits in parts separated by hyphens

noTarget.table: place the caret in a table of the Body view or of an annotation or history field
noTarget.insert: place the caret in the Body view, in an annotation or history field, or in the Source view

reason.notInTable: the caret is not in a table
reason.mixedSelection: the selection reaches outside the table
reason.tableSelected: the whole table is selected; place the caret in a cell
reason.cellInlineOnly: a cell takes inline images only

source.failed: the source could not be loaded
source.analysing: the source is still being read; try again in a moment
source.notWellFormed: the source is not well-formed XML (line {{line}}); correct it first - Go to wrong tag finds the place
source.inTag: the cursor is inside a tag; place it between two elements
source.inMarkup: the cursor is inside a comment, a CDATA section, a processing instruction or a doctype
source.outsideRoot: the cursor is outside the FictionBook element
source.inText: the cursor is inside text; in XML a table can stand only between elements
source.notAllowed: the FB2 schema allows no table at this point of <{{element}}>

problem.pastEnd_one: {{count}} span reaches past the last row
problem.pastEnd_other: {{count}} spans reach past the last row

mark.repairHint: Repair table makes the table regular.

msg.idInvalid: The ID is not valid: an FB2 identifier has no spaces and does not start with a digit.
msg.idInUse: Another element of the book already uses the ID "{{id}}".
msg.langInvalid: "{{value}}" is not a language code: use letters and digits in parts separated by hyphens, such as en or pt-BR.
msg.spanPastEnd: The span would reach past the last column or row of the table.
msg.spanInvalid: A span must be a whole number of 1 or more.
msg.pasteNoPlace: The table cannot be pasted here: no table may stand at the caret.
msg.linkTargets_one: {{count}} link of the book points to a cell that this merge removes, and will lose its target. Merge anyway?
msg.linkTargets_other: {{count}} links of the book point to cells that this merge removes, and will lose their targets. Merge anyway?

table.rowsInvalid: Rows must be a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
table.columnsInvalid: Columns must be a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.

tableMark.title: Irregular table
tableMark.hint: Repair table makes the table regular. No cell content is deleted, and Undo brings the table back.
